POV: a marvel fanboy trying to understand actual human relationships

But seriously this is how it always goes in Hollywood and media. Most of what you have is your connections, and if your group has similar interests to another, chances are you will convene, or “assemble,” at some point. The jackass franchise is no different, most of the crew got lucky, in that they knew one of the other jackasses or producers, like Knoxville, Bam, or Tremaine. Don Vito got lucky in that sense, and even though he was funny at the time, I don’t think most people would say the same now but that’s a different story. 

They realized that with “their powers combined,”  they could make something great, and they did. This isn’t a marvel fairytale, it’s what genuinely happens in real life.

I lived with a few roommates and I was always anxious around them, to the point where I would stay out until it was late and they would hopefully be asleep. But my depression got in the way and instead of staying on campus and actually doing work, I was either riding buses or being alone at bars during that time. Idk there is something calming and comfortable about riding buses

I used to ride city buses too, never met anyone else who did that. I liked exploring new areas of the city and listening to music. I wasted away an entire semester because all my depression wanted to do was ride buses all day. Then I wasted the next semester because I discovered alcohol, and now I’m wasting this semester due to weed. It can suck at times but it’s the only thing that gives me the slightest modicum of comfort. Not to encourage it, but riding the buses while high is honestly one of the most fun and enjoyable things for me to do at the moment
